scenario: 社区搜索（UGC 短文本搜索）：帖子、问答与评论检索；核心指标为相关性 nDCG 和点击率 CTR。

papers.title: VikingRAG: Accurate and Token-efficient Retrieval-augmented Generation over Structured Documents
papers.authors: Peiyuan Gao, Gaoyuan Zhang, Haojie Qin, Yahui Sun, Qianyi Zhang, Yunhao Zhang, Zeyu Wang, Wei Lu
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods exploit document structures to acquire sufficient evidence, but often incur substantial token costs. To reduce structural-context tokens without compromising high RAG accuracy, we present {\sf VikingRAG}, a directory-aware semantic data management system that tightly integrates semantic and structural access to support structural-context-efficient, evidence-gap-driven multi-round retrieval. To further reduce token overhead of multi-round interaction, we materialize agentic multi-round retrieval traces as experience edges, and reuse these edges for similar queries, avoiding repeated multi-round exploration. To additionally reduce token costs when agentic multi-round retrieval is unnecessary, we introduce an adaptive escalation strategy that answers from one-round experience-augmented retrieval when the evidence is sufficient, and invokes agentic multi-round retrieval only otherwise. Experiments on real datasets show that the base system {\sf VikingRAG} matches high accuracy of state-of-the-art methods while consuming only 11.6\%--51.9\% of their tokens. With retrieval-trace reuse and adaptive escalation, token costs drop to 5.1\%--32.5\% while maintaining competitive accuracy and practical document-storage performance, showing the utility of this work for emerging AI knowledge bases.
papers.summary: VikingRAG 针对结构化文档问答的多轮检索成本，将目录、摘要与文本块统一为可寻址对象，并按证据缺口调用检索工具。系统把历史检索路径保存为经验边，再按证据充分性决定是否升级多轮搜索。在六个数据集上，基础版仅消耗高准确率基线的11.6%–51.9% Token，增强版降至5.1%–32.5%，保持相近准确率。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴的是把搜索轨迹转成可复用的证据路径，并让复杂查询按需进入多轮检索。社区 UGC 可将帖子、问答和评论串映射为层级地址，先在重复出现的复杂问题上试验；论文结果来自结构化文档，不能直接视为短文本 nDCG 或 CTR 收益。应同时监测错误停止率、证据覆盖率和查询成本。

papers.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
papers.authors: Shuqi Lu, Chaofan Li, Kun Luo, Zhang Zhang, Hui Wang, Hongwang Xiao, Lei Xiong, Jiahao Wang, Sen Wang, Xiyan Jiang, Wanli Li, Yuyang Hu, Hongjin Qian, Bingyu Yan, Jianlyu Chen, Ziyi Xia, Yingxia Shao, Kang Liu, Zhicheng Dou, Di He, Chaozhuo Li, Qiwei Ye, Zhongyuan Wang, Zheng Liu
papers.abstract: Deep research requires agents to find answers that jointly satisfy multiple constraints. Discovering such answers is costly, whereas verifying a candidate can often be decomposed into tractable constraint-wise checks. This discovery--verification asymmetry suggests that a research agent should do more than simply search longer: it should recursively improve its current answer by verifying intermediate results and using the partially verified state to guide subsequent refinement. We introduce AREX, a family of Recursively Self-Improving (RSI) deep research agents. AREX alternates between an inner research loop that gathers evidence and constructs a provisional answer, and an outer self-improvement loop that audits the answer constraint-wise, identifies unresolved claims, and launches targeted follow-up research. To sustain RSI over long horizons, AREX learns an autonomous context-update tool that compresses growing interaction history into a compact improvement state preserving verified evidence and unresolved constraints, without relying on an external model. We train AREX on verified synthetic tasks and high-quality trajectories through agentic mid-training and long-horizon reinforcement learning. To mitigate sparse final rewards during long horizon learning, we emphasize key steps where decisive evidence is acquired or erroneous research directions are corrected. We instantiate a dense 4B model and a 122B-A10B Mixture-of-Experts model. Across BrowseComp, WideSearch, DeepSearchQA, Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), and other reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, AREX substantially outperforms comparable-scale baselines and remains competitive with models using substantially more activated parameters.
papers.summary: AREX 将深度研究拆成内层证据搜集与外层逐约束核验，并用自主上下文更新保存已证实事实和待解决约束。论文结合关键步骤监督与长程强化学习，提供4B和122B-A10B模型。正文消融中，自主上下文更新使 BrowseComp 单轮准确率从59.6升至71.4；完整训练设置为82.5，改用随机步骤监督后降至74.1。
papers.key_insight: 值得迁移的是保留证据来源、已排除候选及尚未满足的查询条件，避免长对话压缩只留下流畅摘要。UGC 搜索中的多条件咨询可先采用这个状态结构，再评估是否值得训练策略模型。论文首次发表于7月、9月1日修订，本次属于补充阅读；基准准确率与社区 nDCG、CTR 没有直接换算关系。

papers.title: CIVI: A Framework for Diagnosing Search Agent Failures in Civic Information
papers.authors: Dingying Liu, Yunshun Zhong, Wentao Zhang, Yiyuan Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed in public-sector settings, where incorrect guidance can cause irreversible harm. We introduce CIVI, the first framework for diagnosing search agent failures in civic information. Its benchmark instantiation jointly spans cross-national, interjurisdictional government contexts (federal, state, and local) and functional categories from an internationally adopted United Nations standard. We evaluate ten frontier search agents and find that none matches an attentive human baseline. Alongside accuracy, CIVI measures search invocation rate, selective no-search accuracy, and how often agents cite authoritative government sources. To perform this diagnosis, we introduce ARISE, which decomposes agentic search failures into four mutually exclusive modes, isolated via source-injection ablation. ARISE attributes 72.1% of all observed failures to retrieval-bound causes rather than to gaps in the models' parametric knowledge.
papers.summary: CIVI 研究搜索代理为何在公共事务问答中给出错误指引，构建覆盖跨国家、跨行政层级的评测框架。作者用来源注入消融形成 ARISE，将失败拆成四类，并比较搜索调用、无搜索回答和官方来源引用情况。评测的10个前沿搜索代理均未达到认真作答的人类基线，72.1%的失败被归为检索受限。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可以借用来源注入消融：对失败问题直接提供正确帖子或权威证据，再观察答案是否恢复，从而区分找不到资料与读不懂资料。这个诊断比只看最终回答分数更利于定位召回、工具使用和证据利用问题；公共事务任务的72.1%比例不能迁移为 UGC 业务结论，仍需自建样本并联看 nDCG、CTR。

papers.title: 《Agent 评测白皮书》系列01：Agent 评测全览
papers.abstract: 我们推出了《Agent评测白皮书》系列博客，体系化地为大家讲解评测的落地指南，分为《评测全览》、《冷启动篇》、《扩量篇》、《自进化篇》等共4篇，本文为系列的第一篇。
papers.summary: 美团以商家经营分析 Agent 为例，梳理从冷启动到扩量、自进化的评测体系，将其概括为4个模块、3种能力、2条迭代回路和1套资产。线上异常样本经归因分别进入评测标准修订或 Agent 修复，再通过回归与线上实验验证。本文是工业方法论指南，未披露可复核的准确率或线上收益数字，证据质量据此保守评分。
papers.key_insight: 对社区 UGC 搜索，可把复杂查询、错误引用和检索遗漏沉淀为黄金集、错题集及挑战集，并记录每次改动影响的失败类型。评测标准更新与搜索代理更新需要分别追踪，避免模型评分变高却没有用户收益。上线前检查证据与引用，扩量后结合真实查询分布、nDCG 和 CTR 校准离线判断。
